query: list_transactions hasItems=false per active project, fields including budgetCategoryId, purchasedBy, amountCents
note: Key finding: direction is nearly always inferrable from `purchasedBy`. client-card = client already paid (not a billable line). design-business = client owes (charge). The tiny ambiguous group is transactions with no `purchasedBy` field at all.

Jessop.itemsAtRoundOne: see round-1-non-itemized.json; all 24 have purchasedBy populated

rows.whyAmbiguous: No purchasedBy field, no reimbursementType. Category is Furnishings (itemized) but amount is $30.84 and it's an un-itemized purchase — shape alone doesn't tell sign.

inferrableBreakdown.clientCard_untagged: ~61 of 72 — client paid, not billable; nothing to invoice.
inferrableBreakdown.designBusiness_untagged: ~4 — client owes business; bills as a charge. (Sources: cTUXjumZ BLVD Home, hpVKZs Dean Berryessa wallpaper installer, plus a couple in Jessop/Sandra.)
